points_read_xyz — FILEIO points op

• Data kinds: text → points

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.points_read_xyz(data) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.points_read_xyz(data); from the registry, opsfileio.get("points_read_xyz"))

Usage

Read whitespace-delimited XYZ text and return (N,3) points.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

色列は受け付けるが points sort では返さない。列数不一致・非有限値は拒否する。呼び出し例:

points = points_read_xyz(xyz_text)。
